newsitem.title: UK: Rea, Apax form investment trust venture.
newsitem.headline: Rea, Apax form investment trust venture.

text.p: British investment bank Rea Brothers Group Plc said on Thursday it had formed a joint venture with Apax Partners & Co Asset Management Ltd to provide investment management services to British investment trusts.

In a statement Rea said the new company, Apax Finsbury Investment Management Ltd, would take over management of the Finsbury Growth Trust and Finsbury Smaller Trust, which have gross assets of 100 million stg and 64 million stg.
Rea said the trusts and investment advice would be provided by Mark Tyndall, John Dodd, Derek Stuart and Lindsay Whitelaw who had been recruited from Edinburgh fund manager Ivory & Sime Plc.
